safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 3-4 month history of sore and cracked skin on the hands, mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes dry/cracked hands but does not capture the 3–4 month duration nor that it is mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 3–4 month duration and palm predominance reduces clinical clarity about chronicity and pattern, which can affect diagnostic confidence (e.g., irritant/contact dermatitis vs other dermatoses) and follow-up expectations. However, it is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm in this context.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated only states OTC creams with some benefit; it does not document E45 or antihistamine trial, nor the 'minimal relief' characterization.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting prior use of E45 and antihistamines (and that relief was minimal) can lead to redundant recommendations and less informed step-up therapy. This primarily risks inefficiency and delayed symptom improvement rather than serious harm.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated states medications not clearly documented and does not list metformin.
